title: Pushing the limits in Simulating a City, One Page at a Time
description: In which famed designer Stone Librande chronicles the design process of SimCity (2013) and the one-page design paradigm.

title: GTA V surpasses 230 million sales months before GTA VI touches down
description: Those sales were delivered across three console generations.

title: What devs need to know about localization, ft. Concha Fernandez Alvarez, Aurelie Perrin, and Guido Di Carlo
description: We're breaking down what developers need to know about working with localizers to bring their games to different languages.

title: EA taken private by Saudi Arabia, GTA marketing jumps the shark, and Devolver's huge mistake - Patch Notes #64
description: Plus: You need to listen to the new single from The Avalanches.

title: Nintendo Switch 2 hardware sales are down 34.4 percent year-on-year
description: The company's annual hardware forecast remains unchanged despite that downturn.

title: Unity sells Supersonic publishing business to Tripledot for $40M
description: Tripledot says the acquisition will better position it in 'the age of AI in gaming' and give it access to talent in Israel.

title: Halo Studios jettisons long-serving contractors after launch of Halo: Campaign Evolved
description: Some of those departing worked at the Washington studio for multiple years.

title: Rockstar wants you to pay Netflix to watch the next GTA VI trailer before it's released to the masses
description: The 'extended preview' will be available exclusively on Netflix for six hours before heading to YouTube.

title: Devolver wants to delist because indie publishing is not 'compatible' with public trading
description: The indie publisher claims public trading has created a 'valuation disconnect that does not take account of the lifetime and long-tail revenue delivery inherent in the video games business.'

title: Publisher Secret Mode opens development studio to support internal projects
description: The news comes a year after Secret Mode laid off a 'small number' of staff when it went independent.

title: Candy Crush maker King has declined staff's collective bargaining agreement
description: The Microsoft-owned studio says its current benefits are 'in line with, or exceed' what the agreement would offer.

title: Policymakers across Europe told to do more to support local game industry
description: 'The productive capacity and exceptional dynamics of the games industry are indispensable, and it is high time they were put to greater use.'

title: Coffee Stain bullish despite underperformance of Deep Rock Galactic spinoff
description: Meanwhile, the company's popular Roblox title, Welcome to Bloxburg, generated $2.1 million during Q1.

title: EA is now owned by Saudi Arabia and Donald Trump's son-in-law
description: The U.S. publisher has been taken private in a deal worth $55 billion.

title: Devs raise $130,000 in just five days to support laid-off peers
description: The game industry hardship fund bundle, meant to support game workers during ongoing mass layoffs, is over halfway through its goal of 200,000 USD.

title: Word Play is now available on iOS!
description: Word Play is now available on iPhone and iPad. Get the free trial here

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
